verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
ENDAGAANO-entukuvu,
Gye njagalira ddala,
Byonna bye neetaaga nze,
Birabikira mu yo.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Omwoyo-Omutukuvu,
Yagiwandiisa edda;
Teyagunjibwa bantu,
Kyenaavanga ngyesiga.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Bwe nkyama enkomyawo,
Bwemba ngwa ennyimusa,
Bwe siraba mu kkubo,
Eba gye ndi-omusana.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Mu nnaku ensanyusa
Yesu ng'anjigiriza,
Era-ewoomesa gye ndi
Obulamu,n'okufa.
